opening.comment: The agent gave only the company name and did not give their own name, so the opening criterion is not met.

verification.quote: Can I have your full name and order number or postcode?
verification.comment: The agent asked for full name and order number before discussing the order, and the caller provided both.

understanding.quote: So you're asking when the €75.00 comes back?
understanding.comment: The agent captured the refund question correctly and did not ask for information the caller had already given.

resolution_accuracy.quote: Refunds take 10 to 14 working days after we receive the item, so it'll be another week or two.
resolution_accuracy.comment: Policy says the refund is paid within 5 working days of the return reaching the warehouse, so the stated 10 to 14 days and the week-or-two timeline are wrong.

process_compliance.quote: Agent: You'll get an email the day it's paid. Is there anything else I can help you with?
process_compliance.comment: No hold occurred, so the hold step does not apply; the return was a refund case, not a damaged item, so no photo was required, and no step was missed.

communication.quote: Agent: I understand, it's worrying when money is outstanding.
communication.comment: The agent was polite and acknowledged the caller's worry, though the caller's concern was not fully addressed with correct information.

closing.quote: Agent: Thanks for calling, Ahmed, have a good afternoon.
closing.comment: The agent asked if there was anything else and closed politely, but the next-step confirmation relied on an incorrect timeline, so it was not fully accurate.
